traits: Cap 3 to 6 cm, yellowish to olive-brown with a dark centre, slimy, funnel-shaped with age
Gills yellow, running down the stem
Pale yellow flesh turning orange-red when bruised
In pine woods, often in large groups · October and November, with the first frosts
safetyNote: Edible, of variable quality because some are slimy: the DGfM lists it and Wikipedia (en) says so. Wikipedia (en) names the slimy spike-cap as a look-alike: its gills separate easily from the cap, unlike the waxy gills of this species. It has no French Wikipedia page: the text comes from Wikipedia (en) and the DGfM.

sources.title: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Mykologie (DGfM), Fachausschuss Pilzverwertung und Toxikologie (2026). Positivliste der Speisepilze, Stand 1. Mai 2026.
